text_en: Then Elihu continued and said:
text_cn: 厄里乌接着说：

text_en: “Hear my words, you wise men, and give ear to me, you who know;
text_cn: 你们有智慧的人，请听我言；你们明白人，请侧耳听我。

text_en: for the ear tests words as the palate tastes food.
text_cn: 原来耳朵是为辨别言语，有如口腔是为辨尝食物。

text_en: Let us choose what is right; let us determine among ourselves what is good.
text_cn: 让我们来检讨一下谁为正义，让我们看看何者为善。

text_en: For Job has said, ‘I am innocent, and God has taken away my right;
text_cn: 约伯说过：“我是无罪的，但我的理，却为天主夺去。

text_en: in spite of being right I am counted a liar; my wound is incurable, though I am without transgression. ’
text_cn: 我虽无罪无辜，却成了说谎者；我虽未行不义，却受了不可医治的创伤。”

text_en: Who is there like Job, who drinks up scoffing like water,
text_cn: 哪有一人像约伯，肆口漫骂如饮水？

text_en: who goes in company with evildoers and walks with the wicked?
text_cn: 他岂不是与作恶的人结伙，同坏人交结来往？

text_en: For he has said, ‘It profits one nothing to take delight in God. ’
text_cn: 他岂不是说过：“尽心悦乐天主，为人能有什么好处？”

text_en: “Therefore, hear me, you who have sense, far be it from God that he should do wickedness, and from the Almighty that he should do wrong.
text_cn: 为此，你们心地明白的人，请听我说，天主决不行恶，全能者决无不义！

text_en: For according to their deeds he will repay them, and according to their ways he will make it befall them.
text_cn: 他必照人行为报答他，按他的品行对待他。

text_en: Of a truth, God will not do wickedly, and the Almighty will not pervert justice.
text_cn: 天主绝对不能作恶，全能者绝对不能颠倒是非。

text_en: Who gave him charge over the earth and who laid on him the whole world?
text_cn: 谁委派他掌管大地，谁任命他治理普世？

text_en: If he should take back his spirit to himself, and gather to himself his breath,
text_cn: 他若将自己的神魂收回，将气息复归于自己，

text_en: all flesh would perish together, and all mortals return to dust.
text_cn: 所有有血肉的人必都消灭，世人都要归于尘土。

text_en: “If you have understanding, hear this; listen to what I say.
text_cn: 若你聪明，请听这事，侧耳倾听我的话。

text_en: Shall one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn one who is righteous and mighty,
text_cn: 憎恨正义的，岂能掌权？而你竟敢定那至公义者的罪？

text_en: who says to a king, ‘You scoundrel! ’ and to princes, ‘You wicked men! ’;
text_cn: 他能称君王为歹徒，能称官吏为坏人。

text_en: who shows no partiality to nobles, nor regards the rich more than the poor, for they are all the work of his hands?
text_cn: 他对权贵不顾情面，亦不重富轻贫，因为都是他一手造成的。

text_en: In a moment they die; at midnight the people are shaken and pass away, and the mighty are taken away by no human hand.
text_cn: 他们猝然在半夜死去，贵族能立即气绝逝世；他铲除权贵者，无须人手。

text_en: “For his eyes are upon the ways of mortals, and he sees all their steps.
text_cn: 因为他的眼监视人的动作，观察他的行径。

text_en: There is no gloom or deep darkness where evildoers may hide themselves.
text_cn: 没有黑暗，也没有阴影，可将作恶的人掩蔽。

text_en: For he has not appointed a time for anyone to go before God in judgment.
text_cn: 天主不必给人指定时间，为使人到他前去受审。

text_en: He shatters the mighty without investigation, and sets others in their place.
text_cn: 他粉碎权势者，无须审察，即刻能派定别人代替他们。

text_en: Thus, knowing their works, he overturns them in the night, and they are crushed.
text_cn: 他原知道他们的行为，一夜之间将他们推翻消灭。

text_en: He strikes them for their wickedness while others look on,
text_cn: 在众目昭彰之下，鞭打他们有如罪犯。

text_en: because they turned aside from following him, and had no regard for any of his ways,
text_cn: 因为他们远离了他，不重视他一切的道，

text_en: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him, and he heard the cry of the afflicted—
text_cn: 致使穷人的哀号上达于他，使他听到了受苦者的哀求。

text_en: When he is quiet, who can condemn? When he hides his face, who can behold him, whether it be a nation or an individual? —
text_cn: 他若安息，谁敢骚扰？他若掩面，谁敢窥视？他对国对人都予以监视，

text_en: so that the godless should not reign, or those who ensnare the people.
text_cn: 使凡欺压人民的不得为王。

text_en: “For has anyone said to God, ‘I have endured punishment; I will not offend any more;
text_cn: 如果恶人向天主说：“我受了欺骗，以后不再作恶。

text_en: teach me what I do not see; if I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
text_cn: 我所看不透的，求你指教我；我若以前作了孽，不敢再做了。”

text_en: Will he then pay back to suit you, because you reject it? For you must choose, and not I; therefore declare what you know.
text_cn: 他施行报应，岂应随你的心意？或者你能拒绝不受吗？决定的是你，而不是我！你若知道，尽管说罢！

text_en: Those who have sense will say to me, and the wise who hear me will say,
text_cn: 但是心地聪明，具有智慧，且听我说话的人，必要对我说：

text_en: ‘Job speaks without knowledge, his words are without insight. ’
text_cn: “约伯所讲的话毫无知识，他的话全不明智。”

text_en: Would that Job were tried to the limit, because his answers are those of the wicked.
text_cn: 为此，约伯还要受彻底的究察，因为他的答复好似出自恶人之口，

text_en: For he adds rebellion to his sin; he claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God. ”
text_cn: 因为他在罪上又加反叛，当着我们磨拳擦掌，讲出许多相反天主的话。
